title.zh-CN: 反复头痛、眩晕伴走路不稳 · 19岁男性
title.en: Recurrent headache, dizziness and unsteady walking · 19-year-old man

summary.zh-CN: 19岁男性，3个月来反复头痛、眩晕和走路不稳，起病时一侧肢体无力，现收入院进一步检查。
summary.en: A 19-year-old man with three months of recurrent headache, dizziness and unsteady walking, and one-sided weakness when it began, is admitted for further assessment.

In this version (1.1.0) every patient fact is the one extracted from the report for version 1.0.0, reorganised by phase and reworded into the patient's own lay speech; no value, timing, drug or outcome has been added or changed, and the facts have not yet been checked against the full article. learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 在反复头晕、走路不稳和头痛的青年患者中，凭中枢体征（单侧肢体协调障碍、起病时肢体无力）识别后循环缺血，申请含弥散加权的头颅MRI和椎-基底动脉血管成像，而不按前庭病变或偏头痛处理。
learningOutcomes.en: Recognise posterior-circulation ischaemia in a young adult with recurrent dizziness, unsteadiness and headache from central signs (one-sided limb incoordination, limb weakness at onset), and request brain MRI with diffusion imaging and vertebrobasilar vessel imaging instead of treating it as vestibular or migrainous.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 按AHA/ASA 2021指南为19岁缺血性卒中患者制定病因检查：明确动脉病变的性质（夹层、血管炎及其他血管病）、心脏评估（心电图、心律监测、发泡试验超声心动图），按需要做感染、炎症和毒物检查，并查明同型半胱氨酸升高的原因（B12、叶酸、肾功能、氨基酸和基因）。
learningOutcomes.en: Plan the aetiological work-up of an ischaemic stroke in a 19-year-old (AHA/ASA 2021): the nature of the arterial disease (dissection, vasculitis, other vasculopathies), a cardiac evaluation (ECG, rhythm monitoring, echocardiography with bubble contrast), infection, inflammatory and toxicology tests as indicated, and the causes of a raised homocysteine (B12, folate, renal function, amino acids, genetics).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把18.7和29 µmol/L的同型半胱氨酸解读为危险标志而非已证实的病因，区分非特异性高同型半胱氨酸血症（补充B族维生素预防卒中复发无效，AHA/ASA 2021，3类：无获益）与有特异治疗的胱硫醚β合成酶缺乏。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret homocysteine values of 18.7 and 29 µmol/L as a risk marker rather than a proven cause, and distinguish non-specific hyperhomocysteinaemia, in which B vitamins do not prevent recurrent stroke (AHA/ASA 2021, COR 3: No Benefit), from cystathionine β-synthase deficiency, which has a specific treatment.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 影像排除出血后开始单一抗血小板治疗，说明未破裂动脉瘤不是停用的理由（ESO 2022），并拒绝抗凝、首选颅内支架和长期双联抗血小板（AHA/ASA 2021）。
learningOutcomes.en: Start single antiplatelet therapy once imaging has excluded haemorrhage, explain why an unruptured aneurysm is no reason to withhold it (ESO 2022), and reject anticoagulation, intracranial stenting as a first treatment and long-term dual antiplatelet therapy (AHA/ASA 2021).

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 通过神经血管多学科团队处理青年人颅内椎动脉动脉瘤：明确性质、影像随访，只在增大、形态改变或出血时干预，绝不依据过时的造影决定治疗。
learningOutcomes.en: Manage an intracranial vertebral artery aneurysm in a young adult through a neurovascular team — characterise it, follow it with imaging and repair it only for growth, change or bleeding — and never plan treatment on an outdated angiogram.

learningOutcomes.zh-CN: 把基底动脉主干闭塞、后交通动脉侧支供血和动脉瘤不再显影的复查造影解读为病变进展而非痊愈，只对新发急性缺损应用急性再灌注标准（AHA/ASA 2026）。
learningOutcomes.en: Interpret a repeat angiogram showing basilar trunk occlusion with posterior communicating collaterals and an aneurysm that no longer fills as progression rather than cure, and apply acute reperfusion criteria (AHA/ASA 2026) only to a new acute deficit.

chiefComplaint.en: Headaches, dizziness and unsteady walking, on and off for three months

triageNote.zh-CN: 19岁男性，收入院进一步检查。近3个月反复头痛、眩晕、走路不稳；起病时左侧肢体无力；一个多月后再次走路不稳，在当地治疗，当时未复查CT或MRI。目前仍轻度走路不稳。
triageNote.en: 19-year-old man admitted for further assessment. Three months of recurrent headache, dizziness and unsteady walking; left-sided limb weakness at the start; unsteady again more than a month later, treated locally without a repeat CT or MRI. Still mildly unsteady on his feet.

personality.zh-CN: 19岁，说话平静、直接，很配合；想弄明白自己这么年轻为什么会这样。
personality.en: 19, calm, plain-spoken and cooperative; he wants to understand why this is happening to him at his age.

speechStyle.zh-CN: 年轻人的日常口语，句子短；不用医学术语；数字只说医生告诉过他的。
speechStyle.en: A young man's everyday words in short sentences; no medical terms, and numbers only if the doctors told him.

openingLine.zh-CN: 医生，这三个月我头疼、眩晕，走路也不稳，好一阵又犯一阵。
openingLine.en: Doctor, for three months I've had headaches and dizziness, and my walking's been unsteady — it comes and goes.

fallbackUnknown.en: I'm not sure about that, doctor.

concerns.en: I'm only 19 — why is this happening to me?

actingNotes.zh-CN: 清醒、平静、配合，用自己的话描述症状，不用术语。只回答问到的内容，不增减症状、时间或数字。被问到不知道的事——当地给他用了什么药、抽烟喝酒、遗传病以外的家族病史、头痛的具体性质——就说说不上来，绝不编造。医生没有告诉他的检查结果，他一概不知道。
actingNotes.en: Alert, calm and cooperative; describes his symptoms in his own words without medical terms. Answer only what is asked, never adding or changing symptoms, timings or numbers. For anything you do not know — what the local doctors gave him, smoking or drinking, family illness other than inherited disease, what the headaches are like — say you are not sure; never invent. He knows no scan or blood result unless a doctor tells him.

harm.zh-CN: 静脉溶栓用于发病数小时内的急性缺血性卒中：AHA/ASA 2026指南推荐在发病4.5小时内进行（灌注影像显示可挽救脑组织时可延至9小时），《脑血管病防治指南（2024年版）》为4.5小时内、或结合多模影像评估至24小时。他这次住院的记录中没有任何在时间窗内的急性缺损，溶栓只会带来出血风险而没有获益。
harm.en: Thrombolysis treats an acute ischaemic stroke within hours of onset: AHA/ASA 2026 recommends it within 4.5 hours (up to 9 hours only when perfusion imaging shows salvageable tissue), and the 2024 Chinese national cerebrovascular disease guideline uses 4.5 hours, or up to 24 hours with multimodal imaging. Nothing in this admission records an acute deficit inside such a window, so it would add bleeding risk with no benefit.

name.zh-CN: 血管内取栓、球囊扩张或颅内支架置入
name.en: Endovascular thrombectomy, angioplasty or intracranial stenting

dose.zh-CN: 经股动脉入路，在DSA下取栓或做球囊扩张和支架置入
dose.en: Through femoral access under DSA: thrombectomy, or balloon angioplasty with stent placement

harm.zh-CN: 血管内治疗针对造成功能缺损的急性大动脉闭塞，而且要在时间窗内（AHA/ASA 2026指南）；以支架作为颅内动脉狭窄的首选治疗是有害的（AHA/ASA 2021指南，3类：有害）。他没有任何记录在案的新发急性缺损，手术只会让他承担围手术期卒中和死亡的风险，而没有预期获益。
harm.en: Endovascular treatment is for an acute large-artery occlusion causing a deficit, inside its time window (AHA/ASA 2026), and stenting an intracranial stenosis as the first treatment is harmful (AHA/ASA 2021, COR 3: Harm). No new acute deficit is recorded for him, so the procedure would expose him to periprocedural stroke and death with no expected benefit.

name.zh-CN: 全量抗凝（肝素泵入后改华法林）

dose.zh-CN: 普通肝素静脉推注后持续泵入，按APTT调整，再改华法林，INR目标2–3
dose.en: Unfractionated heparin IV bolus then infusion adjusted to the APTT, then warfarin to an INR of 2–3

harm.zh-CN: 他的记录中没有需要抗凝的理由：AHA/ASA 2021指南推荐非心源性缺血性卒中首选抗血小板而非口服抗凝（1类），颅内动脉狭窄所致卒中也首选阿司匹林而非华法林（1类）；对伴缺血的颅内动脉夹层，ESO 2021指南的专家认为抗血小板的获益风险比更好。没有记录心源性栓子来源，抗凝只会增加出血风险而没有已证实的获益。
harm.en: Nothing in his record calls for anticoagulation: AHA/ASA 2021 prefers antiplatelet therapy to oral anticoagulation after a non-cardioembolic ischaemic stroke (COR 1), including stroke from intracranial arterial stenosis (aspirin over warfarin, COR 1), and for an intracranial dissection with ischaemia ESO 2021's experts judged antiplatelets the better balance. No cardiac source of embolism is recorded, so it adds bleeding risk without proven benefit.

name.zh-CN: 神经介入栓塞治疗（弹簧圈或支架辅助栓塞）

dose.zh-CN: 在DSA下用弹簧圈栓塞，必要时支架辅助
dose.en: Coil embolisation under DSA, stent-assisted if needed

harm.zh-CN: 栓塞应由神经血管团队依据当前影像决定：ESO 2022指南建议在多学科团队中评估未破裂动脉瘤、影像随访、增大时再修复，并权衡破裂风险与治疗风险；颅内动脉夹层出血后ESO 2021指南建议尽早修复，而仅表现为头痛者，其专家建议除非增大或出现压迫，否则不做修复。他没有记录出血、增大或压迫，病变性质也未明确；与他现在的血管已不相符的旧造影不能作为治疗依据。
harm.en: Embolisation is a neurovascular team's decision on current imaging: ESO 2022 suggests assessing an unruptured aneurysm in a multidisciplinary setting, monitoring it and repairing it if it grows, weighing rupture risk against treatment risk; for an intracranial dissection, ESO 2021 suggests early repair after a bleed, and its experts advise against repairing a headache-only one unless it grows or compresses. No bleeding, growth or compression is recorded for him and the lesion's nature is not established, and an angiogram that no longer matches his arteries is no basis for treatment.

hint.zh-CN: 每个症状是什么时候出现的？哪些又犯过？现在还剩下什么？对一个19岁的人，还应该问哪些危险因素和既往史？
hint.en: When did each symptom start, which came back, and what is left now? Which risk factors and past illnesses should you ask a 19-year-old about?

guidance.en: He is alert and answers for himself.

hint.zh-CN: 哪些体征能区分中枢性和内耳性的头晕、走路不稳？两侧都要查。
hint.en: Which signs separate a central cause of dizziness and unsteadiness from an inner-ear one? Compare both sides.

hint.zh-CN: 这些症状和体征定位在神经系统的哪里？哪种影像能证实？
hint.en: Where in the nervous system do these symptoms and signs point, and which imaging would show it?

guidance.en: Answer decision 1 on the case board.

title.en: Read the results and weigh the causes

hint.zh-CN: 每份报告说明了什么？同型半胱氨酸升高解释不了哪些发现？对青年卒中，还要查哪些病因？
hint.en: What does each report show, and which findings does a raised homocysteine leave unexplained? What else do you look for in a young adult with a stroke?

guidance.zh-CN: 报告可在病历终端或床旁查看；检查在床旁或相应科室完成。
guidance.en: Read the reports at a records terminal or at the bedside; tests are done at the bedside or in their departments.

hint.zh-CN: 什么能防止他再次卒中？开始之前要确认什么？造影上的异常该由谁、依据什么影像来决定？
hint.en: What will prevent another stroke, and what must you confirm before starting it? Who should decide about the angiogram's abnormalities, and on what imaging?

guidance.zh-CN: 在会诊板上作答决策3和决策4，并开出相应的处理。
guidance.en: Answer decisions 3 and 4 on the case board and give the treatment they call for.

title.zh-CN: 解读再次造影并回顾结局
title.en: Interpret the repeat angiogram and review the outcome

hint.zh-CN: 两次造影之间发生了什么变化？一个不再显影的病变就等于好了吗？最后把原报告的治疗和你的方案比一比。
hint.en: What changed between the two angiograms, and does a lesion that no longer fills mean it has healed? Then compare the report's treatment with your plan.

guidance.zh-CN: 报告在病历终端查看；决策5在会诊板上作答。
guidance.en: Read the reports at a records terminal; answer decision 5 on the case board.

prompt.zh-CN: 19岁男性：反复头痛、眩晕、走路不稳3个月；起病时左侧肢体无力；一个多月后再次走路不稳，在当地治疗，当时未复查CT或MRI；现仍轻度走路不稳。神志清楚，言语流利，颅神经和肌力正常，右侧协调运动较差。你的工作诊断是什么？首先做什么？
prompt.en: A 19-year-old man: three months of recurrent headache, dizziness and unsteady walking; left-sided limb weakness when it began; unsteady again more than a month later, treated locally without a repeat CT or MRI; still mildly unsteady. Alert, speech fluent, cranial nerves and power normal, coordination poorer on the right. What is your working diagnosis, and what comes first?

need.zh-CN: 先问清起病、无力、复发和现在的情况，并完成神经系统检查。
need.en: First take the history of the onset, the weakness, the recurrence and how he is now, and examine his nervous system.

text.zh-CN: 后循环缺血（小脑或脑干）在排除之前优先考虑：做包括弥散加权成像的头颅MRI和椎-基底动脉血管成像，再查找病因
text.en: Posterior-circulation ischaemia (cerebellum or brainstem) until proved otherwise: brain MRI with diffusion imaging and imaging of the vertebrobasilar arteries, then a search for the cause

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。单侧肢体协调障碍和起病时的肢体无力都是中枢体征；3个月内在椎-基底动脉供血区反复发作，即使只有19岁，也应首先考虑后循环缺血。AHA/ASA 2021二级预防指南推荐用头颅CT或MRI确认缺血性脑血管病（1类），并认为颅内大动脉和颅外椎-基底动脉系统的MRA或CTA可有效发现动脉粥样硬化、夹层、烟雾病等血管病变；病因决定之后的二级预防。
feedback.en: Right. One-sided limb incoordination and limb weakness at onset are central signs, and recurrent episodes over three months in the vertebrobasilar territory make posterior-circulation ischaemia the first diagnosis, even at 19. The AHA/ASA 2021 secondary-prevention guideline recommends brain CT or MRI to confirm ischaemic cerebrovascular disease (COR 1) and finds MRA or CTA of the intracranial large arteries and the extracranial vertebrobasilar system effective for atherosclerosis, dissection, moyamoya and other vasculopathies; the cause then shapes prevention.

text.zh-CN: 周围性前庭病变，如前庭神经炎或良性位置性眩晕：做Dix-Hallpike试验并行复位手法、前庭康复训练，这些无效时再做头颅影像
text.en: A peripheral vestibular disorder such as vestibular neuritis or positional vertigo: a Dix–Hallpike test with a repositioning manoeuvre and vestibular rehabilitation, with brain imaging only if these fail

feedback.zh-CN: 位置性眩晕和前庭神经炎不会引起肢体无力或单侧肢体协调障碍，也不会伴头痛在数月内反复发作。按周围性病变处理、无效才做影像，会延误后循环卒中的诊断——这正是年轻眩晕患者最常见的漏诊。
feedback.en: Positional vertigo and vestibular neuritis do not cause limb weakness or one-sided limb incoordination, and they do not recur with headache over months. Treating him as peripheral and imaging only on failure delays the diagnosis of a posterior-circulation stroke — the classic miss in a young adult with dizziness.

text.zh-CN: 前庭性偏头痛（年轻人反复头痛伴眩晕）：记头痛日记，发作时用曲坦类药物并做偏头痛预防，出现警示症状再做头颅影像
text.en: Vestibular migraine, given recurrent headache with dizziness in a young adult: a headache diary, a triptan for attacks and migraine prophylaxis, with brain imaging only if red flags appear

feedback.zh-CN: 出现局灶体征时，偏头痛只能是排除性诊断：单侧协调障碍和起病时的肢体无力就是警示信号，要求先做影像。曲坦类药物有缩血管作用，脑血管病患者应避免使用，而他的脑血管病还没有排除。
feedback.en: Once there are focal signs, migraine is a diagnosis of exclusion: one-sided incoordination and limb weakness at onset are the red flags, and they call for imaging first. Triptans are vasoconstrictors and are avoided in cerebrovascular disease, which has not been excluded here.

text.zh-CN: 青年人多发性硬化首次复发：做钆增强头颅MRI、腰椎穿刺查寡克隆带，并在等待结果时立即静脉用甲泼尼龙冲击
text.en: A first relapse of multiple sclerosis in a young adult: gadolinium-enhanced brain MRI, a lumbar puncture for oligoclonal bands, and IV methylprednisolone now while the results come back

feedback.zh-CN: 反复出现神经功能缺损的年轻人，确实要鉴别脱髓鞘病，MRI也能显示——但这个方案只看脑实质、不查血管，还在确诊前就用大剂量激素。他的表现符合椎-基底动脉供血区，血管影像应同时进行。
feedback.en: Demyelination belongs on the differential of a young adult with relapsing deficits, and an MRI would show it — but this plan images the brain and not the arteries, and starts high-dose steroids before any diagnosis. His pattern fits the vertebrobasilar territory, so vessel imaging belongs in the first step.

prompt.zh-CN: 同型半胱氨酸先为18.7 µmol/L，后为29 µmol/L；血脂正常。他有小脑梗死、一个动脉瘤和后循环多处狭窄。这些数值对他意味着什么？你怎么处理？
prompt.en: Homocysteine was 18.7 µmol/L at first and 29 µmol/L later; lipids were normal. He has a cerebellar infarct, an aneurysm and multiple stenoses in his posterior circulation. What do these values mean for him, and what do you do about them?

need.zh-CN: 先在病历中看头颅MRI、首次造影和血管危险因素化验结果。
need.en: First read the brain MRI, the first angiogram and the vascular risk blood results in the notes.

text.zh-CN: 这是危险标志，不能证明病因：查明升高的原因——维生素B12和叶酸、肾功能、药物、遗传病——同时继续寻找他动脉病变的病因
text.en: A risk marker, not proof of cause: find why it is raised — B12 and folate, renal function, medicines, inherited disorders — and keep searching for the cause of his arterial disease

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。同型半胱氨酸升高与卒中相关，但不能证明它导致了这种多发性动脉病变。胱硫醚β合成酶缺乏指南（Morris 2017）要求先排除维生素B12、叶酸缺乏和肾功能不全，再结合血浆蛋氨酸和基因检测判断遗传性病因。AHA/ASA 2021指南认为，对伴高同型半胱氨酸血症的缺血性卒中，补充叶酸、B6和B12预防复发无效（3类：无获益）；有缺乏就按缺乏治疗，同时继续寻找动脉病变的病因。
feedback.en: Right. Raised homocysteine is associated with stroke but does not prove that it caused this multifocal arteriopathy. The cystathionine β-synthase deficiency guideline (Morris 2017) asks first to exclude vitamin B12 and folate deficiency and renal impairment, with plasma methionine and genetic tests for an inherited cause. AHA/ASA 2021 judged folate, B6 and B12 not effective for preventing recurrent stroke in hyperhomocysteinaemia (COR 3: No Benefit): treat a deficiency on its own merits and keep looking for the arterial cause.

text.zh-CN: 这些数值已足以确诊经典型同型半胱氨酸尿症（胱硫醚β合成酶缺乏）：开始用维生素B6、甜菜碱和低蛋氨酸饮食，并转代谢专科长期随访
text.en: These values establish classical homocystinuria (cystathionine β-synthase deficiency): start pyridoxine, betaine and a low-methionine diet, and refer him to metabolic medicine for life

feedback.zh-CN: 未经治疗的胱硫醚β合成酶缺乏，同型半胱氨酸通常高于100 µmol/L，轻型可以较低（Morris 2017）——18.7和29 µmol/L不足以确诊。确诊需要血浆蛋氨酸、酶活性或基因检测；AHA/ASA 2021关于维生素B6和饮食治疗的1类推荐只适用于已确诊的胱硫醚β合成酶缺乏。
feedback.en: In untreated cystathionine β-synthase deficiency homocysteine is usually above 100 µmol/L, though milder forms run lower (Morris 2017) — 18.7 and 29 µmol/L do not establish it. The diagnosis needs plasma methionine, enzyme or genetic confirmation, and AHA/ASA 2021's COR 1 pyridoxine-and-diet recommendation applies only once the deficiency is proven.

text.zh-CN: 高同型半胱氨酸血症已能解释梗死、狭窄和动脉瘤，病因已经明确：停止其他病因检查，用B族维生素作为他的卒中预防
text.en: Hyperhomocysteinaemia accounts for the infarct, the stenoses and the aneurysm, so the cause is settled: stop the aetiological work-up and make B vitamins his stroke prevention

feedback.zh-CN: 这样过早停止了病因探查。危险因素不等于发病机制：19岁、有梗死、多处狭窄和一个动脉瘤的患者，仍需要明确动脉病变的性质（夹层、血管炎或其他血管病）并检查心脏。AHA/ASA 2021指南认为B族维生素预防卒中复发无效（3类：无获益）——它们不能作为他的卒中预防。
feedback.en: This stops the search too early. A risk factor is not a mechanism: a 19-year-old with an infarct, multiple stenoses and an aneurysm still needs the nature of his arterial disease established (dissection, vasculitis, another vasculopathy) and his heart examined. AHA/ASA 2021 found B vitamins not effective for preventing recurrent stroke (COR 3: No Benefit) — they cannot be his prevention.

text.zh-CN: 低于30 µmol/L的水平对青年卒中没有意义：不必为此再做检查或治疗，病因检查直接转向他的心脏和血管壁
text.en: Levels below 30 µmol/L do not matter in a young stroke: no further tests or treatment for them, and the work-up moves straight on to his heart and his vessel walls instead

feedback.zh-CN: 从18.7升到29 µmol/L并不正常，其原因可能可以治疗——维生素B12或叶酸缺乏、肾病、药物或遗传病。查B12、叶酸和肾功能代价小却可能改变处理（Morris 2017）；直接忽略会漏掉这些，尽管它单独难以解释他的动脉病变。
feedback.en: A level that rose from 18.7 to 29 µmol/L is not normal, and its cause may be treatable — vitamin B12 or folate deficiency, renal disease, medicines or an inherited disorder. Checking B12, folate and renal function is cheap and can change management (Morris 2017); dismissing it misses that, even though it is unlikely to explain the arterial disease on its own.

prompt.zh-CN: MRI：右侧小脑梗死。首次DSA：左椎动脉颅内段5×2 mm动脉瘤；右小脑上/后下动脉起始段及左大脑后动脉狭窄。你现在开始哪种二级预防治疗？
prompt.en: MRI: right cerebellar infarct. First DSA: a 5×2 mm aneurysm of the intracranial left vertebral artery; stenosis at the origins of the right superior/posterior inferior cerebellar arteries and of the left posterior cerebral artery. Which secondary-prevention treatment do you start now?

need.zh-CN: 先在病历中看头颅MRI和首次造影报告。
need.en: First read the brain MRI and the first angiogram reports in the notes.

text.zh-CN: 影像确认为梗死且没有出血后，每日阿司匹林单药抗血小板；未破裂的动脉瘤不是停用的理由
text.en: Aspirin daily as a single antiplatelet drug once imaging confirms an infarct without haemorrhage; the unruptured aneurysm is no reason to withhold it

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。CT或MRI确认缺血性卒中且无出血后，AHA/ASA 2021指南推荐非心源性卒中首选抗血小板而非抗凝（1类），可用阿司匹林50–325 mg/d或氯吡格雷75 mg/d（1类）；《脑血管病防治指南（2024年版）》也以阿司匹林或氯吡格雷单药为首选。ESO 2022指南不建议因未破裂动脉瘤停用为其他适应证（如卒中预防）服用的阿司匹林。加用氯吡格雷90天只适用于近期（30天内）70%–99%的颅内动脉狭窄——他的狭窄程度没有记录。
feedback.en: Right. Once CT or MRI has confirmed an ischaemic stroke without haemorrhage, AHA/ASA 2021 recommends antiplatelet therapy rather than anticoagulation for non-cardioembolic stroke (COR 1) — aspirin 50–325 mg daily or clopidogrel 75 mg (COR 1); the 2024 Chinese national cerebrovascular disease guideline also names aspirin or clopidogrel alone as first choice. ESO 2022 does not suggest stopping aspirin taken for another indication, such as stroke prevention, because of an unruptured aneurysm. Adding clopidogrel for 90 days applies only to a recent (≤ 30 days) 70–99% intracranial stenosis — the degree of his stenoses is not recorded.

text.zh-CN: 用叶酸、甲钴胺和维生素B1/B6把同型半胱氨酸降下来，在动脉瘤未处理、仍可能出血之前暂停一切抗血小板药物
text.en: Folic acid, mecobalamin and vitamins B1/B6 to bring the homocysteine down, holding every antiplatelet drug while an untreated aneurysm could still bleed

feedback.zh-CN: 这样他就没有卒中预防。AHA/ASA 2021指南认为补充叶酸、B6和B12预防高同型半胱氨酸血症患者卒中复发无效（3类：无获益），而非心源性卒中后的抗血小板治疗是1类推荐。ESO 2022指南不建议因未破裂动脉瘤停用为卒中预防服用的阿司匹林。
feedback.en: This leaves him without stroke prevention. AHA/ASA 2021 found folate, B6 and B12 not effective for preventing recurrent stroke in hyperhomocysteinaemia (COR 3: No Benefit), whereas antiplatelet therapy after a non-cardioembolic stroke is COR 1. ESO 2022 does not suggest stopping aspirin taken for stroke prevention because of an unruptured aneurysm.

text.zh-CN: 先用肝素桥接再改华法林，INR目标2–3，以抗凝而不是抗血小板来治疗血栓性颅内动脉病变
text.en: Heparin cover, then warfarin to an INR of 2–3, treating a thrombotic intracranial arteriopathy with anticoagulation rather than antiplatelet drugs

feedback.zh-CN: AHA/ASA 2021指南推荐50%–99%颅内动脉狭窄首选阿司匹林而非华法林（1类），非心源性卒中首选抗血小板而非口服抗凝（1类）；对伴缺血的颅内动脉夹层，ESO 2021指南的专家认为抗血小板的获益风险比更好。存在颅内动脉瘤且没有记录心源性栓子来源时，抗凝只会增加出血风险。
feedback.en: AHA/ASA 2021 recommends aspirin in preference to warfarin for a 50–99% intracranial stenosis (COR 1) and antiplatelet therapy over oral anticoagulation for non-cardioembolic stroke (COR 1); for an intracranial dissection with ischaemia, ESO 2021's experts judged antiplatelets the better balance. With an intracranial aneurysm present and no cardiac source recorded, anticoagulation adds bleeding risk.

text.zh-CN: 阿司匹林联合氯吡格雷长期使用，并以狭窄动脉的球囊扩张和支架置入作为首选治疗，尽早处理每一处狭窄
text.en: Aspirin with clopidogrel continued indefinitely, and angioplasty with stenting of the narrowed arteries as the first treatment, dealing with every stenosis early

feedback.zh-CN: 两部分都有害。AHA/ASA 2021指南：70%–99%颅内动脉狭窄不应以球囊扩张和支架作为初始治疗，50%–69%狭窄做支架会增加致残和死亡（均为3类：有害）；阿司匹林联合氯吡格雷持续超过90天会增加出血（3类：有害）。何况他的狭窄性质和程度都还没有明确。
feedback.en: Both parts do harm. AHA/ASA 2021: angioplasty and stenting should not be the initial treatment of a 70–99% intracranial stenosis, and for a 50–69% stenosis they add morbidity and mortality (both COR 3: Harm); aspirin with clopidogrel continued beyond 90 days carries excess haemorrhage (COR 3: Harm). The nature and degree of his stenoses are not even established.

prompt.zh-CN: 首次DSA显示左椎动脉颅内段5×2 mm动脉瘤，同时后循环其他动脉有狭窄，并有小脑梗死。现在你怎么处理这个动脉瘤？
prompt.en: The first DSA shows a 5×2 mm aneurysm of the intracranial left vertebral artery, alongside stenoses in other posterior arteries and a cerebellar infarct. How do you manage the aneurysm now?

need.zh-CN: 先在病历中看头颅MRI和首次造影报告。
need.en: First read the brain MRI and the first angiogram reports in the notes.

text.zh-CN: 神经血管团队评估：结合其他动脉判断其性质（夹层性或囊状），继续抗血小板，复查血管影像，增大、改变或出血时才处理
text.en: Neurovascular team review: characterise it (dissecting or saccular) with his other arteries, keep antiplatelet therapy and repeat vessel imaging; repair only for growth, change or bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。如为囊状动脉瘤，ESO 2022指南建议在多学科团队中评估、影像随访观察是否增大、增大时修复；5×2 mm的病变出现在伴缺血表现和多处狭窄的年轻人身上，也可能是夹层性的——ESO 2021指南指出，未破裂颅内动脉夹层是否修复缺乏证据，专家对仅表现为头痛者建议除非随访中增大或出现压迫，否则不做血管内或手术治疗。抗血小板治疗继续。
feedback.en: Right. If it is saccular, ESO 2022 suggests assessment in a multidisciplinary setting, imaging follow-up for growth and repair if it grows. A 5×2 mm lesion in a young man with ischaemia and stenoses elsewhere may instead be dissecting: ESO 2021 found no evidence to guide repair of an unruptured intracranial dissection, and its experts advised against endovascular or surgical treatment of the headache-only form unless it enlarges on follow-up or compresses. Antiplatelet therapy continues.

text.zh-CN: 本次住院就行弹簧圈栓塞或支架辅助栓塞：年轻人的后循环动脉瘤终生破裂风险很高，越早处理越安全，术后再调整抗血小板
text.en: Endovascular coiling or stent-assisted coiling during this admission, because a posterior-circulation aneurysm in a young man carries a high lifetime risk of rupture and early repair is safest

feedback.zh-CN: 部位确实是破裂的危险因素之一，但立即修复跳过了ESO 2022指南要求的步骤——由多学科团队权衡年龄、大小、部位和形态——而且它的性质（夹层性还是囊状）尚不清楚。支架辅助栓塞意味着要长期双联抗血小板；对一个可能重塑或自发血栓化的病变，手术带来的卒中风险没有已证实的获益来抵消。
feedback.en: Site is a real rupture risk factor, but immediate repair skips the steps ESO 2022 asks for — a multidisciplinary decision weighing age, size, site and shape — and its nature (dissecting or saccular) is unknown. Stent-assisted coiling commits him to dual antiplatelet therapy, and treating a lesion that may remodel or thrombose exposes him to procedural stroke without proven benefit.

text.zh-CN: 尽快开颅夹闭或孤立该段椎动脉，动脉瘤处理好之前暂不用任何抗血小板药物，以免增加出血风险
text.en: Open surgical clipping or trapping of that vertebral segment as soon as possible, deferring antiplatelet drugs until the aneurysm has been secured to avoid bleeding

feedback.zh-CN: 颅内椎动脉开颅手术有损伤后组颅神经和脑干的实际风险；把抗血小板治疗推迟到术后，会让刚发生梗死的后循环失去保护。记录中没有出血、增大或压迫，没有需要紧急修复的理由。
feedback.en: Open surgery on the intracranial vertebral artery carries a real risk of lower cranial nerve and brainstem injury, and deferring antiplatelet therapy until afterwards leaves a recently infarcted posterior circulation unprotected. Nothing recorded — no bleeding, growth or compression — calls for urgent repair.

text.zh-CN: 无需处理：小于7 mm的动脉瘤几乎不会破裂，他既不需要治疗也不需要复查影像，安慰后即可出院
text.en: No action: an aneurysm under 7 mm almost never ruptures, so he needs neither treatment nor follow-up imaging, and he can go home reassured

feedback.zh-CN: 大小只是破裂风险因素之一：ESO 2022指南把部位和形态也列为危险因素，并建议对未处理的动脉瘤影像随访观察是否增大；他还年轻，暴露时间长达数十年，而可能是夹层性的病变在数周内就可能变化。
feedback.en: Size is only one risk factor: ESO 2022 also lists site and shape, and suggests imaging follow-up of untreated aneurysms for growth. He is young, with decades of exposure ahead, and a lesion that may be dissecting can change within weeks.

prompt.zh-CN: 再次造影：基底动脉主干闭塞，双侧大脑后动脉由后交通动脉供血；原左椎动脉瘤不再显影。这说明什么？你怎么处理？
prompt.en: Repeat angiography: the basilar artery trunk is occluded; both posterior cerebral arteries are supplied through the posterior communicating arteries; the previous left vertebral aneurysm no longer opacifies. What does this mean, and what do you do?

need.zh-CN: 先在病历中看再次造影报告。
need.en: First read the repeat angiography report in the notes.

text.zh-CN: 不是痊愈：它在新发现的基底动脉闭塞旁不再显影。立即复查——有新缺损走急性卒中流程，否则继续抗血小板和随访
text.en: Not a cure: it stops filling beside a newly documented basilar occlusion. Re-examine him now: a new deficit means the acute stroke pathway; if none, continue antiplatelet therapy and follow-up

feedback.zh-CN: 正确。与基底动脉主干闭塞出现在同一次造影上，动脉瘤不显影可能是血栓形成或血流改变的结果，不是治愈的证据，而动脉病变已经进展；双侧大脑后动脉现在依靠后交通动脉供血。记录没有说明他当时有无新症状：有新的缺损就立即走急性流程（AHA/ASA 2026：发病24小时内、NIHSS≥10、PC-ASPECTS≥6的基底动脉闭塞做取栓）；没有，就没有可再灌注的对象，继续抗血小板治疗和随访。
feedback.en: Right. Non-opacification of the aneurysm on the same study as a basilar trunk occlusion may reflect thrombosis or a change in flow; it is not evidence of cure, and the arteriopathy has progressed, with both posterior cerebral arteries now depending on the posterior communicating arteries. Whether he had new symptoms then is not recorded: a new deficit sends him down the acute pathway (AHA/ASA 2026: thrombectomy for a basilar occlusion within 24 hours with NIHSS ≥ 10 and PC-ASPECTS ≥ 6); without one there is nothing to reperfuse, and antiplatelet therapy with surveillance continues.

text.zh-CN: 动脉瘤已经血栓化并痊愈，症状的根源随之消失：可以停用抗血小板药物，结束血管随访，写好门诊小结后安排他出院回家
text.en: The aneurysm has thrombosed and healed, so the source of his symptoms has gone: stop the antiplatelet drug, end the vascular follow-up and discharge him home with a letter to his clinic doctor

feedback.zh-CN: 不显影的病变可以再充盈或再通，同一次造影还显示动脉病变在进展——基底动脉主干闭塞。在后循环依靠侧支供血的时候停用抗血小板和随访，恰恰撤掉了他的保护。
feedback.en: A lesion that stops filling can refill or recanalise, and the same angiogram shows the arterial disease advancing — a basilar trunk occlusion. Stopping antiplatelet therapy and follow-up now removes his protection exactly when the posterior circulation depends on collaterals.

text.zh-CN: 基底动脉闭塞无论何时发现都是急症：立即静脉溶栓，并直接送介入室做基底动脉取栓和支架置入
text.en: A basilar occlusion is an emergency whenever it is found: give IV thrombolysis now and take him straight to the angiography suite for basilar thrombectomy and stenting

feedback.zh-CN: AHA/ASA 2026指南推荐发病4.5小时内静脉溶栓（灌注影像支持时至9小时），基底动脉闭塞在发病24小时内、NIHSS≥10且PC-ASPECTS≥6时取栓。这里没有任何证据表明是急性事件——没有记录新的缺损，闭塞时间不明，且已有侧支供血——两者都只会让他承担出血和操作风险而没有预期获益。
feedback.en: AHA/ASA 2026 recommends IV thrombolysis within 4.5 hours of onset (to 9 hours with perfusion imaging) and thrombectomy for a basilar occlusion within 24 hours with NIHSS ≥ 10 and PC-ASPECTS ≥ 6. Nothing here establishes an acute event — no recorded new deficit, an occlusion of unknown age, collateral supply already present — so both expose him to haemorrhage and procedural risk with no expected benefit.

text.zh-CN: 开始全量肝素，再改华法林，INR保持2–3，以再通基底动脉并防止血栓向大脑后动脉蔓延
text.en: Start full-dose heparin, then warfarin at an INR of 2–3, to reopen the basilar artery and stop the thrombus spreading into the posterior cerebral arteries

feedback.zh-CN: 抗凝不能使闭塞的基底动脉再通；AHA/ASA 2021指南在非心源性卒中后首选抗血小板而非抗凝（1类）。同一循环中还有动脉瘤或夹层段，抗凝只增加出血风险而没有已证实的获益。
feedback.en: Anticoagulation does not reopen a basilar occlusion, and AHA/ASA 2021 prefers antiplatelet therapy to anticoagulation after a non-cardioembolic stroke (COR 1). With an aneurysm or dissected segment in the same circulation, it adds bleeding risk without proven benefit.

text.zh-CN: 问清起病时的症状和左侧无力、一个多月后的复发和当地治疗、现在的情况，以及高血压和血脂、中枢神经系统感染和遗传病史
text.en: Took the history of the onset and the left-sided weakness, the recurrence more than a month later and its local treatment, how he is now, and his blood pressure and lipid history, central nervous system infection and inherited disease

text.zh-CN: 追问会改变检查方向的信息：头痛的性质（是否突发剧烈）、颈部疼痛或外伤、其他脑干症状、吸烟饮酒和毒品、家人年轻时的卒中或血栓（都没有记录：问到就是能力）
text.en: Asked about what changes the work-up: the character of the headache (sudden and severe?), neck pain or injury, other brainstem symptoms, smoking, alcohol and drugs, and stroke or clots in young relatives (none recorded: asking is the competency)

text.zh-CN: 检查神志和言语、颅神经、肌力和两侧协调运动
text.en: Examined his conscious level and speech, cranial nerves, power and coordination on both sides

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把后循环缺血作为工作诊断，并以脑和椎-基底动脉影像为第一步（决策1）
text.en: Made posterior-circulation ischaemia the working diagnosis, with brain and vertebrobasilar imaging first, at the first attempt (decision 1)

text.zh-CN: 在影像和化验阶段看过头颅MRI、首次造影和血管危险因素化验，并在再次造影阶段看过再次造影报告
text.en: Read the brain MRI, the first angiogram and the vascular risk bloods in the results phase, and the repeat angiography report when it came

text.zh-CN: 按青年卒中送检病因检查：心电图、发泡试验超声心动图、维生素B12和叶酸、肾功能、血管壁磁共振、炎症和自身免疫筛查、梅毒和HIV
text.en: Sent the work-up of a stroke in a young adult: ECG, echocardiogram with bubble contrast, vitamin B12 and folate, renal function, vessel-wall MRI, inflammatory and autoimmune screen, syphilis and HIV serology

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把升高的同型半胱氨酸看作需要查明原因的危险标志，而不是已证实的病因（决策2）
text.en: Treated the raised homocysteine as a risk marker whose cause must be found, not a proven cause, at the first attempt (decision 2)

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即选择排除出血后的单药抗血小板治疗（决策3）
text.en: Chose single antiplatelet therapy after haemorrhage is excluded at the first attempt (decision 3)

text.zh-CN: 看过头颅MRI之后、看到再次造影之前开始阿司匹林
text.en: Started aspirin after reading the brain MRI and before the repeat angiography result

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把动脉瘤交给神经血管团队评估和随访（决策4），并提交了多学科讨论
text.en: Referred the aneurysm for neurovascular team assessment and follow-up at the first attempt (decision 4), and made the referral

text.zh-CN: 首次作答即把再次造影解读为病变进展而非痊愈（决策5），并请卒中团队立即复查
text.en: Read the repeat angiogram as progression rather than cure at the first attempt (decision 5), and had the stroke team re-examine him

text.zh-CN: 没有静脉溶栓，也没有做血管内取栓、球囊扩张或颅内支架
text.en: Gave no thrombolysis and arranged no endovascular thrombectomy, angioplasty or intracranial stenting

text.zh-CN: 没有抗凝，没有在多学科决定之前做栓塞，也没有在看过脑部影像之前给阿司匹林
text.en: Gave no anticoagulation, no embolisation ahead of a team decision, and no aspirin before the brain imaging had been read

text.zh-CN: 安排步态和平衡康复评估，并交代病情、卒中警示症状和生活方式
text.en: Arranged a gait and balance assessment, and explained the plan, the stroke warning signs and lifestyle advice

text.zh-CN: 用他能理解的话说明诊断、病因的不确定性、治疗计划和警示症状，并用复述确认理解
text.en: Explained the diagnosis, the uncertain cause, the treatment plan and the warning signs in words he understands, and checked understanding by teach-back

judgeGuidance.zh-CN: 按Calgary–Cambridge评价与这位19岁患者的谈话：开场先问他已经知道什么、最担心什么（他想知道为什么这么年轻会这样、会不会再犯）；用通俗的话说明：小脑有一处小的中风，后循环几支血管有狭窄，还有一个小的动脉瘤；同型半胱氨酸偏高是线索之一，但还不能解释全部，病因还要继续查；为什么每天吃阿司匹林，为什么单靠维生素不能预防再次中风；动脉瘤为什么先由专科团队评估、定期复查，而不是马上手术。讲清警示症状：突然剧烈头痛，或突发口角歪斜、一侧无力、说话不清、看东西重影、走路明显不稳，要立即打急救电话。复查造影显示基底动脉闭塞时，按SPIKES告知这一坏消息：先了解他的认知，说明侧支供血和目前的不确定性，不作虚假保证。不评判地询问吸烟、饮酒和毒品（都没有记录）。最后请他复述关键内容以确认理解。本病例没有记录与他的谈话。
judgeGuidance.en: Judge the conversation with this 19-year-old by Calgary–Cambridge: open by asking what he already understands and what worries him most (why this is happening at his age and whether it will happen again); explain in plain words a small stroke in the cerebellum, narrowing in several arteries at the back of the brain and a small aneurysm; that the raised homocysteine is one clue but does not explain everything, so the search for the cause goes on; why he takes aspirin every day and why vitamins alone cannot prevent another stroke; and why the aneurysm is assessed by a specialist team and watched rather than operated on now. Teach the warning signs — a sudden severe headache, or sudden facial droop, one-sided weakness, slurred speech, double vision or much worse balance — and to call an ambulance at once. When the repeat angiogram shows the basilar occlusion, break the news with SPIKES: find out what he knows, explain the collateral supply and the uncertainty, no false reassurance. Ask about smoking, alcohol and drugs without judgement (none is recorded). Close with teach-back. This case does not record a conversation with him.

name.zh-CN: 乔医生（神经内科主治医师，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 苏格拉底式带教，只围绕学员已经拿到的资料提问，例如：“他的哪些体征是内耳病变解释不了的？”“右侧协调障碍的病灶在哪里？起病时左侧无力又提示什么？”“同型半胱氨酸升高能解释什么、解释不了什么？”“开始抗血小板之前必须确认什么？”“未破裂的动脉瘤是停用阿司匹林的理由吗？”“造影上一个病变不显影了，就等于痊愈了吗？”。可以讲AHA/ASA 2021二级预防指南、AHA/ASA 2026急性缺血性卒中指南、ESO 2021动脉夹层指南、ESO 2022未破裂动脉瘤指南、2017年胱硫醚β合成酶缺乏指南和《脑血管病防治指南（2024年版）》的相关原则。用PEARLS框架复盘。原报告的处理是历史记录，在病例结束时才展示，届时再与现行指南对照。不提前说出诊断、任何决策的正确选项或结局。以下内容没有记录，不要替它补上：生命体征、心电图、超声心动图、B12和叶酸、肾功能、各处狭窄的程度、动脉瘤的形态、各项检查和两次同型半胱氨酸的时间、当地的治疗、吸烟饮酒和毒品，以及再次造影时他的症状。
knowledge.en: A Socratic teacher who asks only about what the learner already has, for example: 'Which of his signs could an inner-ear problem not produce?', 'Where is a lesion that causes right-sided incoordination, and what does the left-sided weakness at onset add?', 'What does a raised homocysteine explain, and what does it not?', 'What must you confirm before he starts an antiplatelet drug?', 'Is an unruptured aneurysm a reason to withhold aspirin?', 'If a lesion stops filling on an angiogram, has it healed?'. May explain the relevant principles of the AHA/ASA 2021 secondary-prevention guideline, the AHA/ASA 2026 acute ischaemic stroke guideline, the ESO 2021 artery dissection guideline, the ESO 2022 unruptured aneurysm guideline, the 2017 cystathionine β-synthase deficiency guideline and the 2024 Chinese cerebrovascular disease guideline. Debriefs with PEARLS. The report's management is a historical record shown at the end of the case and compared with current guidance only then. Never states the diagnosis, any decision's correct option or the outcome early. Not recorded — do not supply: vital signs, ECG, echocardiogram, B12 and folate, renal function, the degree of each stenosis, the aneurysm's shape, the dates of the studies and of the two homocysteine values, the local treatment, smoking, alcohol or drug use, and his symptoms at the repeat angiography.

knowledge.zh-CN: 神经内科病房护士。交班（ISBAR）：19岁男性，收入院进一步检查；近3个月反复头痛、眩晕、走路不稳，起病时左侧肢体无力，一个多月后再次走路不稳，在当地治疗，当时未复查CT或MRI；现在仍轻度走路不稳，神志清楚。没有记录他的生命体征、体重和过敏情况。可以抽血、做心电图、装动态心电图、发口服药，安排去磁共振室或介入室；复述医嘱，只报告已经出来的结果，没有记录的就如实说没有记录；不解读结果，不下诊断。
knowledge.en: Neurology ward nurse. Handover (ISBAR): 19-year-old man admitted for further assessment; three months of recurrent headache, dizziness and unsteady walking, left-sided limb weakness at the start, unsteady again more than a month later and treated locally without a repeat CT or MRI; still mildly unsteady, alert. No vital signs, weight or allergy status are recorded for him. Can take bloods, record an ECG, fit a Holter monitor, give oral medicines and arrange transfer to MRI or the angiography suite; reads back orders, reports only results that are back and says plainly when something is not recorded; does not interpret results or diagnose.

name.zh-CN: 陆医生（神经外科/神经介入，化名）

knowledge.zh-CN: 神经介入医生，只解读学员已经看过的造影。可以讲：囊状与夹层性（梭形）颅内动脉瘤的区别，以及三维造影和血管壁磁共振如何帮助区分；为什么一个5×2 mm的病变出现在伴多处狭窄的年轻人身上，要考虑夹层或其他动脉病变；神经血管团队评估未破裂动脉瘤要权衡的因素（年龄、大小、部位、形态、是否增大；ESO 2022），以及为什么不因此停用为卒中预防服用的阿司匹林；ESO 2021动脉夹层指南的建议和专家共识（伴缺血的颅内夹层倾向抗血小板；出血后尽早修复；仅头痛者除非增大或压迫不做修复）；为什么支架不是颅内动脉狭窄的首选治疗（AHA/ASA 2021）；学员看过再次造影后，可以讲AHA/ASA 2026关于急性基底动脉闭塞取栓的标准。不说出任何决策的答案，不补充病例没有记录的测量值（狭窄程度、动脉瘤形态、检查日期）。
knowledge.en: Neurointerventional neurosurgeon who interprets only angiograms the learner has read. Can explain: saccular versus dissecting (fusiform) intracranial aneurysms and how 3D angiography and vessel-wall MRI help tell them apart; why a 5×2 mm lesion beside multiple stenoses in a young man raises the question of a dissection or another arteriopathy; what a neurovascular team weighs for an unruptured aneurysm (age, size, site, shape, growth; ESO 2022) and why aspirin taken for stroke prevention is not stopped because of one; the ESO 2021 dissection guideline's suggestions and expert consensus (antiplatelets favoured for an intracranial dissection with ischaemia; early repair after a bleed; no repair of a headache-only one unless it grows or compresses); why stenting is not the first treatment of an intracranial stenosis (AHA/ASA 2021); and, once the learner has read the repeat angiogram, the AHA/ASA 2026 criteria for thrombectomy in an acute basilar occlusion. Never gives a decision's answer and adds no measurement the case does not record (stenosis degrees, the aneurysm's shape, dates).

title.zh-CN: 复盘：19岁男性后循环卒中伴颅内动脉病变
title.en: Debrief: posterior-circulation stroke with an intracranial arteriopathy at 19

conclusion.zh-CN: 19岁男性，反复头痛、眩晕、走路不稳3个月：起病时左侧肢体无力，一个多月后再次走路不稳，在当地治疗，当时未复查CT或MRI；入院时仍轻度走路不稳，神志清楚、言语流利，颅神经和肌力正常，右侧协调运动较差。MRI示右侧小脑梗死；首次DSA示左椎动脉颅内段5×2 mm动脉瘤，右小脑上/后下动脉起始段及左大脑后动脉狭窄。同型半胱氨酸先为18.7 µmol/L、后为29 µmol/L，血脂正常；既往无高血压、高脂血症，否认遗传病和中枢神经系统感染史。再次造影示基底动脉主干闭塞，双侧大脑后动脉由后交通动脉供血，原动脉瘤不再显影。原报告给予叶酸、甲钴胺及维生素B1/B6，两个月随访无明显症状，仍在随访；没有记录抗栓治疗。今天的做法：影像确认梗死、排除出血后开始单药抗血小板；按青年卒中全面查找病因（动脉、心脏、代谢、炎症和感染）；查明同型半胱氨酸升高的原因，而不是靠维生素预防复发（AHA/ASA 2021：无效）；动脉瘤由神经血管团队依据当前影像决定；把动脉瘤不显影与新发现的基底动脉闭塞一起解读为病变进展，而不是痊愈。
conclusion.en: A 19-year-old man had three months of recurrent headache, dizziness and unsteady walking, with left-sided limb weakness at onset and unsteadiness again more than a month later, treated locally without a repeat CT or MRI. On admission he was still mildly unsteady, alert with fluent speech, with normal cranial nerves and power and poorer right-sided coordination. MRI showed a right cerebellar infarct; the first DSA, a 5×2 mm aneurysm of the intracranial left vertebral artery with stenosis at the origins of the right superior/posterior inferior cerebellar arteries and of the left posterior cerebral artery. Homocysteine was 18.7 then 29 µmol/L and lipids normal; he had no history of hypertension or hyperlipidaemia and denied hereditary disease and CNS infection. Repeat angiography showed the basilar trunk occluded, both posterior cerebral arteries supplied through the posterior communicating arteries and the aneurysm no longer opacifying. The report gave folate, mecobalamin and vitamins B1/B6; at two months he had no prominent symptoms and follow-up continued; no antithrombotic treatment is recorded. Today: start a single antiplatelet drug once imaging confirms the infarct without haemorrhage; search for the cause of a young stroke (arteries, heart, metabolic, inflammatory and infective causes); find the cause of the raised homocysteine rather than relying on vitamins to prevent recurrence (AHA/ASA 2021: not effective); decide on the aneurysm in a neurovascular team on current imaging; and read an aneurysm that stops filling beside a newly documented basilar occlusion as progression, not cure.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 头晕、走路不稳伴单侧肢体协调障碍，以及起病时的肢体无力，都是中枢体征：19岁、3个月内反复发作，应指向后循环缺血，而不是内耳疾病或偏头痛。
keyReasoning.en: Dizziness and unsteadiness with one-sided limb incoordination, and limb weakness at onset, are central signs: in a 19-year-old with recurrent episodes over three months they point to posterior-circulation ischaemia, not an inner-ear disorder or migraine.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: MRI证实右侧小脑梗死，造影显示后循环多支动脉受累——一个动脉瘤和多处狭窄：这是伴多发动脉病变的青年卒中，必须明确病变性质（夹层、血管炎、其他血管病或早发动脉粥样硬化），同时检查心脏。
keyReasoning.en: The MRI confirms a right cerebellar infarct and the angiogram shows several posterior arteries involved — an aneurysm and multiple stenoses: a young adult's stroke with a multifocal arteriopathy whose nature (dissection, vasculitis, another vasculopathy, early atherosclerosis) must be established, alongside a cardiac search.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 同型半胱氨酸先18.7、后29 µmol/L，是需要查明原因的危险标志（B12或叶酸缺乏、肾功能不全、遗传病）；它低于未经治疗的经典型同型半胱氨酸尿症通常的水平，单凭它解释不了这种动脉病变。
keyReasoning.en: Homocysteine of 18.7 and then 29 µmol/L is a risk marker with causes to look for (B12 or folate deficiency, renal impairment, inherited disorders); it lies below the levels usual in untreated classical homocystinuria and does not by itself explain the arteriopathy.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 预防不能等病因查清：影像确认为梗死且无出血后，单药抗血小板是基础；未破裂的动脉瘤不改变这一点，而抗凝、首选颅内支架和长期双联抗血小板只会增加伤害。
keyReasoning.en: Prevention cannot wait for the cause: once imaging shows an infarct without haemorrhage, a single antiplatelet drug is the cornerstone; an unruptured aneurysm does not change that, while anticoagulation, first-line intracranial stenting and long-term dual therapy only add harm.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 动脉瘤由神经血管团队依据当前影像决定——明确性质、随访观察，只在增大、改变或出血时修复。
keyReasoning.en: The aneurysm is a neurovascular team decision on current imaging — characterise it, follow it, and repair it only for growth, change or bleeding.

keyReasoning.zh-CN: 再次造影上，动脉瘤不显影与基底动脉主干闭塞及侧支供血出现在同一次检查中：病变进展了，病灶并没有愈合；只有新的急性缺损才需要考虑急性再灌注。
keyReasoning.en: On the repeat angiogram the aneurysm stops filling on the same study that shows a basilar trunk occlusion with collateral supply: the disease has progressed, the lesion has not healed, and only a new acute deficit would bring acute reperfusion into question.

boundaries.zh-CN: 这是单个病例报告，本版本的患者事实只来自1.0.0版的提取，尚未对照原文全文核对：它不能证明任何治疗的效果，也不能确定动脉病变的性质。原报告的处理作为历史事实保留；决策、干预和评分依据现行指南设计，属于教学设计。各项检查的时间没有记录：本病例在决策1之后才打开头颅MRI、首次造影和化验结果，把两次同型半胱氨酸放在同一份结果中，把再次造影放在其后的阶段，并让患者在随访阶段用自己的话讲述两个月随访的情况——这些都是教学安排。
boundaries.en: This is a single case report, and in this version its patient facts come only from the version 1.0.0 extraction, not yet checked against the full article: it cannot show the effect of any treatment or settle the nature of the arteriopathy. The report's management is kept as historical fact; the decisions, interventions and scoring follow current guidance and are educational design. The timing of the studies is not recorded: the case opens the brain MRI, the first angiogram and the blood results only after decision 1, keeps the two homocysteine values in one result, places the repeat angiography in a later phase and lets the patient describe the two-month follow-up in his own words in the outcome phase — all teaching staging.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 两种高同型半胱氨酸血症，两种答案（AHA/ASA 2021二级预防指南）：伴高同型半胱氨酸血症的缺血性卒中，补充叶酸、B6和B12预防复发无效（5.9节，3类：无获益；VITATOPS 2010、VISP 2004）；而已确诊的胱硫醚β合成酶缺乏要用维生素B6和低蛋氨酸饮食把同型半胱氨酸降到正常（5.14节，1类）。原报告给予叶酸、甲钴胺和维生素B1/B6，没有记录抗栓治疗。
teachingPoints.en: Two kinds of hyperhomocysteinaemia, two answers (AHA/ASA 2021 secondary-prevention guideline): in ischaemic stroke with hyperhomocysteinaemia, folate, B6 and B12 are not effective for preventing recurrence (§5.9, COR 3: No Benefit; VITATOPS 2010, VISP 2004), whereas proven cystathionine β-synthase deficiency is treated with pyridoxine and a low-methionine diet to bring homocysteine to normal (§5.14, COR 1). The report gave folate, mecobalamin and vitamins B1/B6, and no antithrombotic treatment is recorded.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 非心源性卒中后的抗栓选择（AHA/ASA 2021）：首选抗血小板而非抗凝（1类）——阿司匹林50–325 mg/d或氯吡格雷75 mg/d（1类）；近期（30天内）70%–99%颅内动脉狭窄可加氯吡格雷最长90天（2a类）；不以球囊扩张或支架作为初始治疗，双联抗血小板不超过90天（均为3类：有害）。《脑血管病防治指南（2024年版）》的首选方案相同。
teachingPoints.en: Antithrombotic choice after a non-cardioembolic stroke (AHA/ASA 2021): antiplatelet therapy rather than anticoagulation (COR 1) — aspirin 50–325 mg daily or clopidogrel 75 mg (COR 1); for a recent (≤ 30 days) 70–99% intracranial stenosis, clopidogrel added for up to 90 days (COR 2a); no angioplasty or stenting as the initial treatment and no dual therapy beyond 90 days (both COR 3: Harm). The 2024 Chinese national cerebrovascular disease guideline gives the same first choices.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 未破裂动脉瘤与抗血小板（ESO 2022未破裂颅内动脉瘤指南）：在多学科团队中评估，未处理者影像随访观察是否增大，增大时修复；不因动脉瘤停用为卒中预防等其他适应证服用的阿司匹林。若是夹层，ESO 2021指南没有试验证据，专家认为伴缺血的颅内动脉夹层用抗血小板比抗凝更好。
teachingPoints.en: Unruptured aneurysm and antiplatelets (ESO 2022 unruptured intracranial aneurysm guideline): assess in a multidisciplinary setting, follow an untreated aneurysm with imaging for growth and repair it if it grows, and do not stop aspirin taken for another indication such as stroke prevention. If the lesion is a dissection, ESO 2021 found no trial evidence, and its experts favoured antiplatelets over anticoagulants for an intracranial dissection with ischaemia.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 青年卒中的病因检查（AHA/ASA 2021诊断评估）：头颅CT或MRI、心电图、基础化验（血常规、凝血、血糖、糖化血红蛋白、肌酐、血脂）和颅内及椎-基底动脉的MRA或CTA；病因仍不明（隐源性卒中）时，做含或不含声学造影的超声心动图和心律监测，并按需要查高凝状态、可致血管炎的感染（HIV、梅毒）、毒品、全身炎症指标和遗传病。胱硫醚β合成酶缺乏指南（Morris 2017）补充：在认定同型半胱氨酸升高为遗传性之前，先排除B12、叶酸缺乏和肾功能不全。
teachingPoints.en: Work-up of a stroke in a young adult (AHA/ASA 2021 diagnostic evaluation): brain CT or MRI, an ECG, basic bloods (blood count, clotting, glucose, HbA1c, creatinine, lipids) and MRA or CTA of the intracranial and vertebrobasilar arteries; while the cause is not found (cryptogenic stroke), echocardiography with or without contrast, rhythm monitoring and, as indicated, tests for hypercoagulable states, infections that cause vasculitis (HIV, syphilis), drug use, systemic inflammation and inherited diseases. The cystathionine β-synthase deficiency guideline (Morris 2017) adds: exclude B12 and folate deficiency and renal impairment before calling a raised homocysteine inherited.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 急性再灌注只针对急性事件（AHA/ASA 2026急性缺血性卒中指南）：发病4.5小时内静脉溶栓（灌注影像支持时至9小时），基底动脉闭塞在24小时内、NIHSS≥10且PC-ASPECTS≥6时取栓。后来的造影上发现的基底动脉闭塞，闭塞时间不明且已有侧支，需要的是床旁重新评估，而不是条件反射式的溶栓或支架。
teachingPoints.en: Acute reperfusion is for acute events (AHA/ASA 2026 acute ischaemic stroke guideline): IV thrombolysis within 4.5 hours of onset (to 9 hours with perfusion imaging), thrombectomy for a basilar occlusion within 24 hours with NIHSS ≥ 10 and PC-ASPECTS ≥ 6. A basilar occlusion found on a later angiogram, of unknown age and with collateral filling, calls for a bedside reassessment — not reflex thrombolysis or stenting.

teachingPoints.zh-CN: 不显影不等于愈合：动脉瘤与新发现的动脉闭塞同时出现、不再显影时，可能是血栓形成或失去了流入血流，之后还可能再通。每一次造影都要结合整个循环和上一次检查来读，绝不依据已与血管现状不符的影像安排手术。
teachingPoints.en: A lesion that stops filling has not necessarily healed: an aneurysm that no longer opacifies on the same study as a newly documented occlusion may have thrombosed or lost its inflow, and can recanalise. Read each angiogram against the whole circulation and the one before, and never plan a procedure on images that no longer match the arteries.
